digest.component_or_area: LLM framework / Pydantic AI provider integration
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when infer_model constructs models with the ambiguous `openai:` prefix, indicating v2 will change it from Chat Completions to Responses.
Rebar's `_pai_model` and model-class `_resolve_target` functions compose or preserve the ambiguous `openai:` target, triggering the warning at runtime.
Normalizing all rebar-composed `openai:` targets to the explicit `openai-chat:` qualifier preserves Chat Completions semantics and eliminates the deprecation warning.

ProviderSession's cfg.base_url builder and per-candidate endpoint-override gates only match the legacy `openai` provider name, so they must recognize `openai-chat:` to maintain custom-endpoint routing.
Configured `openai` and `openai-chat` providers and inline `openai:` and `openai-chat:` qualifiers must be treated as one family for conflict detection and resolve canonically to `openai-chat:`.
Real model construction and loopback custom-endpoint tests confirm no change to Chat Completions payloads, endpoint routing, or structured-output profile behavior after normalization.
